name: What common home improvement projects increase property value in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: What common home improvement projects increase property value in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: In the competitive Bay Area housing market, kitchen and bathroom remodels consistently offer high returns on investment. Other value-adding projects include adding an accessory dwelling unit (ADU) where permitted, enhancing curb appeal with landscaping, and upgrading to energy-efficient windows or solar panels. Investing in these areas not only improves your living space but also makes your home more attractive to potential buyers, aligning with local preferences and sustainability trends.
acceptedAnswer.description: Kitchen and bathroom remodels, ADUs, landscaping, and energy-efficient upgrades are common home improvement projects that increase property value in the Bay Area.
